issue.title: macOS master CI exhausts its 45-minute job deadline compiling bob-obsidian
issue.description: On clean master 1f6cc7bedbeb6786202d9e003dad3b1cbccd4911, run 44308576558 / macOS job 134816454974 starts cargo test at 13:11:54Z, compiles bob-obsidian from 13:14:08Z, then cancels at 13:40:50Z near the 45-minute job deadline; no test verdict, presenter cases/cache save skipped. Linux, lint, and package pass. n7.2 records the same failure on snapshot run 44308634344, and closed epic mj reports earlier occurrences; do not infer all cancellations are timeouts. Diagnose compile/cache/resource cost and make macOS coverage finish reliably without dropping lint/test/presenter coverage, test budgets, or workloads. Distinct from l9/n6/kl correctness failures and from later ms.8.2 rustfmt blocker. n7 landing needs green macOS evidence; coordinate with its closeout tale rather than duplicate its fixture fix. Size large: infrastructure remediation needs diagnosis/planning; exact compile bottleneck unconfirmed. Same-type and broad searches, all 68 last-week tasks, and 15 active epics reveal no semantic duplicate or causal active epic.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both clean master and the same-content precommit snapshot exhausted the job deadline during compilation, with no test output; this is CI infrastructure rather than a timing assertion. Job log and timestamps independently checked by n7 lander.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-n7.2 note #3; landing independently confirmed a clean master run dies during compilation before the tests can verify the portability repairs. No node-specific task owns this infrastructure failure.

payload.description: Compile timeout withheld the macOS regression verdict for the symlink fix
Pipe-drain portability also needs the macOS CI job to finish

payload.entry: Resolved by exact-tree run 44408541155, snapshot 2dfbcb85d861f5f73ef6da8b059f7e6b25651ade: macOS job 135170175416 completed Run tests and Run archive-move presenter cases successfully. Job-level CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG evaluates to 0 for matrix.os macos-latest. The job completed in 41m55s within its unchanged 45-minute deadline; no test, presenter, optimization, assertion, or overflow-check coverage was removed.
